import json
H,W=22,26
g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
def box(r0,r1,c0,c1,border,fill):
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if r in (r0,r1) or c in (c0,c1): g[r][c]=border
            elif (r-r0-1 + c-c0-1)%2==0: g[r][c]=fill
box(1,6,3,11,1,4)
box(10,13,2,5,2,8)
box(9,16,11,21,3,5)
print(json.dumps(g))
